segments.text: pwede nang ang isang nalululong sa sugal ay pwede nang sumulat sa amin,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kasama ang kanyang pamilya, pwede na rin i-request na pagbawalan ang isang kapamilya nila

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: o mismo yung tao na makapagsugal.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At gusto ko pong ipagbigay alam sa lahat,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: 15,000 na po ang naaprobahan ng mga,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ang PAGCOR in the last year for self-exclusion.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang ibig sabihin po nito, your honor, sila po, naka-alerto na po ang lahat ng land-based casinos natin

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: at ganyan din po naman yung ating online licenses.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Nang sa ganon, hindi po pwede nang makapasok at makapagsugal yung inaprobahan po ng PAGCOR

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: na nag-apply ng tinatawag na self or family exclusion.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yan po, your honor, ay parte ng aming mga programang ginagawa para nga po matulungan natin yung ating mga kababayan na nalululong sa sugal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ito pong mga tinanong ko dahil nabanggit niyo po kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ang market po kasi ay CDE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang pinaka-vulnerable po dito sa pagkalulong sa sugal, lalong-lalo na sa online sugal, ay ang mga manggagawa at ordinaryong Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Totoo po, nasasabihin ng marami na personal na choice kung ikaw ay magsusugal o hindi.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Pero para sa isang gipit na manggagawa, makikita niya halimbawa si Ivana Alawi, si Vice Ganda, si Vic Soto na magpo-promote ng sugal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: aakalain nila na pwede naman pala kaming magsugal para lang makatawid dito sa aming bahay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Kaya ko po ito pinapatungkulan, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: dahil napakalaking issue po ang online sugal sa bansa natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Marami po ang nalululong, marami pong mga manggagawa, ang nagsasangla.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Dating may kotse, ngayon may motor. Dating may motor, hahatakin yung motor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: So kailangan maging equally liable itong mga influencer, content creator,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: pati na rin yung kanilang mga mother company, yung mga kumpanya na pinopromote nila dahil grabe po ang social harm at social cost ng pagkalulong sa sugal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: At Madam Chair, natutuwa po ako dahil kaisa po natin ang PAGCOR, binanggit po na merong commitment para sawatahin itong mga online influencer at content creator na nagpopromote,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: walang habas na nagpopromote ng online sugal. Yun lamang po Madam Chair, maraming salamat po.

Committee Secretary

segments.text: Liodi Odi-Tariela, Vice Chair Maria Cristina Talavera-Lopez, Representative Citi Amina

segments.text: DiMaporo, Deputy Majority Leader Mica Gonzalez, Vice Chair Loreto Amante, Vice Chair Arne

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Fern-DeBella, and Representative Mica Gonzalez, and also Representative Julius Cesar Vergara.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: May I now move to our next interpellator from the majority?

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Madam Chair, fellow colleagues, PAGCOR family, headed by Chairman Alejandro Tengco, pleasant

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ay Madam Chair, meron ba tayong breakdown ng income ng PAGCOR?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, meron ka nandun po sa ating ulat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Hindi ko siya mabasa rito eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: But anyway, pakibigyan na lang ako.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And then, nasa page 4 po, upper portion, nandun po yung comparable results of operations for 2025,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: which was actual, Your Honor, 2026 estimated po, sapagkat kalahati ang palamputay ng taon,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: at saka yung projected po for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: No, I need the breakdown ng income ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Parang example, STL, magkano ba na kukontribute ng STL sa atin?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Hindi po sa amin ng STL, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sa PCS, o po yun, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Yung sa online gaming, magkano ba na kukontribute natin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But from the gaming operations po, in page 4, kung inyo pong makikita,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Halos sa ngayon po, Your Honor, nakalalamang na ng konti yung online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, halos sabihin na po natin, tabla siya sa around 50% po,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ay nagmumula sa land-based casinos, at 50% po, ay nagmumula sa online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, kung titignan nyo po yung ulat,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: halos 40 billion pesos po, ang inaasahang maging kita ng online gaming,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: at pagkatapos po naman, 40 billion din po, ang maging kita ng land-based casino licenses po natin, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Based sa report, 2024 is 111 billion tayo, diba?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: And then, based sa report, 2025 is 165.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Bumaba po ito dahil effective po noong 2025, pinagbawal na po yung POGO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ayan po ay nawalam po tayo.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Projected for 2025, mga 10 billion piso po ang nawala po sa atin noon, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ano ang paraan para bumalik natin ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Meron ba tayong mga naisip na pamamaraan na po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Meron ba tayong mga naisip na pamamaraan ng PAGCOR para bumalik ang nawawala na pamalit ng POGO?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, talagang nagkoconcentrate po ang PAGCOR, Your Honor sa...

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: nasa sa 50% lang po ang nakaka-capture na market natin,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ...nasa sa 50% lang po ang naka-capture na market natin,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang tinutukoy ko po, limampung porsyento po ng industriya ng online gaming ay legal, limampung porsyento po ay iligal.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, doon po, ang aming mga programa talaga ay papano mahikayat yung mga iligal na maging legal.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sapagat sabi ko nga eh, because of the advances of technology, napakahirap na po talagang maalis itong online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Eh, ang aming po ang kinukonsentratan ngayon is papano mahikayat.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At maganda naman po ang nagiging resulta, meron na po ilang malalaking iligal na online gaming operators na gusto na po mag-apply sa PAGCOR ng lisensya.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pangalawa po, pinalalakas din po ng PAGCOR ngayon yung tinatawag na Special Class BPO.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang ating pong bansa ay kilalang napakalakas sa industriya ng business processing outsourcing.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Eh, nakita po namin, Your Honor, marami pong backroom operations ng malalaking mga land-based operations at online gaming operations abroad.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang pwede pong dito na sa Pilipinas magkaroon ng backroom operations.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Gusto ko pong bigay na halimbawa ang isa sa pinakamalaking kasino sa buong mundo, MGM.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Nandito na po ang backroom operations nila, Your Honor, sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At dito na po ang kanilang HR, accounting, at saka yung mga graphics design ginagawa.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Meron pong humigit kumulang dalawang milyong, eh, dalawang libong empleyadong Pilipino na po.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At bukod po ron, tinatarget po namin na ito ay palakasin ng sa ganon, una, makapagdagdag po ng trabaho sa ating kapwa Pilipino na nangangailangan ng trabaho sa pangkasalukuyan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: As a BPO worker, hindi po ito sumesweldo ng minimum wage.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang sweldo po nito ay nasa sa range ng P35,000 to P50,000.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At pangalawa, meron pong additional revenue ang PAGCOR sapagkat ibat-ibang uri po ng fees ang nakukulikta namin sa kanila.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, inaasahan ko po na by 2026, meron pong humigit kumulang mga 2.5 hanggang 3 billion piso po

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, yun po ang pang-neutralize natin dito sa nangyayaring paghina ng land-based operations at saka ng online gaming po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Madam Chair, tulad ng sinabi ni Congressman Ili ng Manggagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: maraming kabataan ang nalululong sa online, hindi lang kabataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ano ba ang mga proseso natin para mabawasan ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Or, ano ang dapat natin gawin?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: isa sa mga income ng PAGCOR at isa sa mga initiative ng PAGCOR

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: na ginagawa ninyo ay magpagawa ng mga school building.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Nakalagay dito, nationwide school building program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Nakikita yung inyong mga tarpulin na gawa ng PAGCOR

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ng mga estudyante, kabataan, elementary and high school.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Sasabi nila, ay, galing sa PAGCOR yung school building namin, magtataya kami sa online.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Yes. Kasi iba yung produkto ng pag-iisip ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Nakita lang natin sa mga TV, kung saan-saan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: na yung social media natin, napakabilis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Nagdala-dala ng mga baril yung kabataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Ganun din ang nakikita ko rito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Bakit hindi natin palitan ito ng mga programa na mga katulong pa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: bakit instead of school building program ang ilagawa natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: bakit hindi natin sundin yung gusto nang mangyari ng ating Pangulo

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: during SONA, na sinabi niya magpapagawa siya ng maraming evacuation center

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Kaysa makikita ng mga kabataan na yung pala school building gawa ng PAGCOR

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: galing sa sugal ng online, tataya kami.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Baka sakaling mas magandang evacuation center na lang ang ipagawa natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: sa mga typhoon prone area na talaga namang kailangan ngayon

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: at binanggit ito ng ating Pangulo during SONA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: At pangalawa, wala po akong nakikita rito na pundo

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Dissemination program sa mga schools, elementary and high schools

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: para ang pagsusugal ay hindi tama, lalong-lalong na sa kabataan

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Kasi hindi lang namang po matatanda o may edad

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Kinakikita nyo sa iba-iba, lalo sa Metro Manila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Meron, namimigay tayo ng transport vehicle sa mga pasyente,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: mga food packs during a calamity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: ang gawin na lang natin ay evacuation center na lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: At idagdag natin ang information dissemination campaign

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: sa mga eskwilahan, magdagdag tayo ng pundo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, we will take note of your suggestions.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yes, we do not have, but maybe,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: gusto ko lang pong banggitin dito.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Isa po talaga sa programa ng PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: yung pagpapatuloy na magpagawa ng mga evacuation centers.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero it has been overcome by the memorandum of agreement

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: that we have signed with the Department of Education.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Napakalaki din ang backlog ng mga classrooms natin, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kaya minarapat na rin po ng Administrasyon pangasulukuyan na talagang ito o not,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: bigyan na ng pansin yung pagpapagawa ng mga eskwelahan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero we will consider your suggestions and, Your Honor, we will see how we can balance your suggestion with our current programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair. Lastly, what is the status of PAGCOR Casino Privatization Initiatives?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jose "Bong" J. Teves Jr.
segments.text: Paano natin itong magiging efektibo sa ating revenue at sa pagkakawala ng maraming trabano?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Salamat po sa katanungan niyo, Congressman Odi.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sa pangasulukuyan po ay iniintay na lang po ng PAGCOR ang desisyon ng GCG.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Or yung Governance Commission for GOCCs na isumiti na po namin ang aming mga datos na hiningi nila.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At sila po bilang nasa sa ilalim kami ang siyang magre-rekomenda sa tanggapan ng Pangulo

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: yung pagpapatuloy po ng tinatawag na privatization or decoupling.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang balita ko po ay baka po hindi marating ang last quarter.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Magkaroon na po ng desisyon tungkol dito.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Tunay po kasing napakabigat na rin ang kargan ng Casino Filipino, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Dahil sa panahon pong ako ay nanunungkulan sa PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: napanglaki na po ng lugi ng Casino Filipino branches po namin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kaya wala na po talagang dapat gawin kung hindi.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I-unload na po ito sa pribadong sektor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, we are just waiting for the recommendation of GCG to the Office of the President.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And as I said, we were told it will be coming out very soon.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Tungkol naman po sa maapekto ang mga empleyado,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ako po ay imikot na halos sa lahat ng ating mga Casino Filipino sites sa buong Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At pinaliwanag ko po sa lahat ng empleyado maapekto ham.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Na una, yung kanila pong retirement ay babayaran.

segments.text: pagdating dito sa pagsasagawa natin ng mas pinalakas na helpline para sa ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang 24-7 National Problem Gambling Helpline. Maraming salamat Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Maraming salamat din po, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, Representative Elago. We'll consolidate the whole list of the documentary requests

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: to PAGCOR and then we'll follow up.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We'll follow up with them later on. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We'll move to our next interpellator from the majority, Representative Salvador Pleyto.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Good morning, Madam. Thank you, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Sa ating colleagues and our esteemed guests, Chairman Alteco, sa ating PAGCOR family,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Dalawang tanong lang po, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: I reported that the total revenues, I don't know kung tama yung akin o yung sinabi ni Chairman kanina,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Chairman Mika, ng first half of 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: while PAGCOR's net income ay bumaba o nag-fail ng 85.29%.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Tama po ba ito, Chairman Al?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor. Tama po yung binanggit nyo.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Tulad po ng aking pagpapaliwanag earlier,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kung ano po yung mga kadahilanan ng pagbaba na yun sa pangkasalukuyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Madam Chair, Chairman Al, in light of this significant decline,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: ano po, what concrete measures will PAGCOR implement to reverse this trend

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: and increase gross gaming revenue to JGR, particularly sa electronic at online gaming sector?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, tulad po nung naiulot ko kanina,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: una, malakas po ang programa namin ngayon sa paghihikayat sa mga iligal na operator

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Dahil ang paniwala ko po sa pangkasalukuyan sa industriya,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, very positive naman, Your Honor, ang aming programa

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: sapagkat meron na po kaming mga natatanggap ng mga feelers

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: para mag-surrender na ang ilang malalaking iligal na magpalisensya na po sa pangkasalukuyan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Number two, tulad nung binanggit ko kanina sa katanungan ni Congressman Odi earlier,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: aming pong minomonitor ng husto ang income na or GGR or operations ngayon

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ng mga online gaming companies sa pamamagitan ng isang third-party auditor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Doon po ay aming nakikita kung tunay pang nairimit nila or dinideklara nila yung tama nilang gross gaming revenue.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At gusto ko pong ibalita sa inyo,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: malaki na rin po ang naging pagtaas ng mga gross gaming revenue ng online gaming operators

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: dahil naalaman nila at nakikita nilang nakatutok ang isang third-party auditor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At panghuli po ay nag-ikayat kami na sana'y marami pang mag-apply dito sa special class BPO

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kung saan po yung mga nasa ibang bansa na mga malalaking operator ay gamitin na ang Pilipinas

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: bilang kanilang mga backroom operations ay dito na gawin sa Maynila.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Very encouraging, Your Honor, Kong Ador, itong binabanggit ko sapagkat sa ngayon po eh,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: nasa sa nung linunsad po namin yung programa, two-fold po,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: bukod sa may karagdagang kita sa PAGCOR, may himigit kumulang po sa 7,500 empleyado na

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ang nasabing sektor nito na hindi nagbabayad ng minimum wage,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kundi nagbabayad ng mga rates ng customer service agents ng mga BPO.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So this amounts to an average of...

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So yun po ang aming ginagawa sa pangkasulukuyan,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: and we're also hoping, Your Honor, Kong Ador,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: na dumating yung pagkakataon na matapos na rin yung crisis sa Middle East,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: nang sa ganun eh, medyo pag nakaluwag-luwag naman sila eh,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ang tao eh, marami na rin ang magpe-patronize ng ating mga naroon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Thank you, Chairman Al, for that response.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Specifically, what is PAGCOR's strategy in terms of improving its regulatory framework,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: expanding the legitimate gaming market, strengthening its digital monitoring and collection system,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: and addressing illegal and unlicensed operators,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: and also attracting responsible investment into the Philippine gaming industry.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Doon po sa katanungan ninyo, Your Honor, una,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: sa structure po, wala pong sawa kaming nagre-review ng aming structures and guidelines regularly

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: para nang sa ganun ma-improve ito.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yan po ay patutunayan ng updated structure ng online gaming rules ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Halos po buwan-buwan, meron po kaming mga adjustments na ginagawa

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: para ito po ay matama at maging ma-responsive sa pangkasulukuyang sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Number two, kami po ay patuloy na dumalabas at nagsasabi,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: nag-a-attend sa mga konbensyon, ngayon din naman ang mga exhibits abroad,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: at nagsasabing bukas ang Pilipinas sa paglilesensya ng land-based casinos,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ngayon din naman ng ating online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Hindi man dapat sabihin, pero pwede na rin ipagmalaki na dito po sa Asia,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Head to head na with Singapore.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And I believe, malaking bagay po itong darating na privatization,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: sapagkat pagdakailam na po at ang nagpatakbo na po ng mga kasino

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: na sa pangkasulukuyan ay pinapatakbo ng PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: naniniwala po ko it will be a game changer.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sapagkat pag ang pribadong sektor na ang nagpapatakbo ng negosyo,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Eh sa pangkasulukuyan, your honor, we cannot compete head on with our licenses.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yung kasino Filipino, your honor, wala man lang kaming kwarto na mga hotel na inalok.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Wala kaming mga restaurants, wala kaming mga mall, wala kaming mga prebileyong maipagkaloob.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Dahil wala namang yung mga properties natin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero pag ang kasino Filipino po at itong mga properties natin ay na-privatize na,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: naniniwala po ako, yung bibili ng pribadong kumpanya,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: eh magagawa na ng hakbang yan para lumakas ang kanilang kasino.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At pag lumakas ang kasino, sapagkat tayo ay mga umalik tala lang ng license fees,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: tatas din rin automatic ang income ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kaya yan po ang mga pangkasulukuyang mga ginagawa namin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At hopefully nga, pagka ito pong decoupling privatization ay maganap na,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: malaki po ang magiging epekto nito sa kita ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: eh masakit man sabihin, ang average po namin na pasweldo sa tao ay mahigit isang billion piso sa isang buwan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Tapos ang average na binabayad namin sa upa ng mga kasino properties namin,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Eh yun lang po, maalis natin sa corporate expense ng PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: na parang naking bagay na po na ito para lang sa ganun,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: maitulong yan ng PAGCOR sa nation building at sa ating kapwa mamamayang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: At Madam Chair, pwede ba yung remaining time ko,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: bigay ko sa aking kaibigan, kay Congressman Dumugan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: kasi napakarami namang nangyaring mga nasirang infrastruktura doon sa Koldilyera,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: lalo ng Baguio-Binguet, sa infrastructure, saka agriculture.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Ito po, Mr. Chair, Madam Chair, I would like to place on record,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: that despite the significant decline in its gross gaming revenues and net income,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: PAGCOR has continued to fulfill its social responsibility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Gusto ko pa sa salamatan ng mga taga PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: May sincere appreciation yung binanggit kanina ni Assistant President Balcos, si Eric,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: tungkol po doon sa JBL, Children's Medical Center, in Clark, Pangpanga,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: which was recently inaugurated by our beloved President Bongbong Marcos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Ito po ay this very important investment for those children needing specialized medical care.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Salamat kami mga taga Central Luzon, lalo na ang Bulacan, malapit doon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: at yung mga taga Central Luzon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Saka lahat po tayo, kasi para sa mga batang mga isakit,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: napakaganda hindi na tayo pupunta ng Manila, doon na lang tayo sa Clark.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: Ito ay totoo po naman po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: nung nangyari yung mga typhoons and earthquakes, recent earthquakes in Mindanao,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: itong mga typhoons na nangyari dahil sa monsoon, south-west monsoon, itong habagat,

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: alam ko ang PAGCOR, they continue to affect many parts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: PAGCOR once again stands ready to provide assistance in our disaster-stricken communities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: At the time, Madam Chair, when government resources are stretched

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: frequency and severity of natural disasters, this commitment is truly commendable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: It demonstrates that PAGCOR's role goes beyond gaming and revenue generation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: It is also an institution that contributes to nation building, ang sabi mo kanina, and

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: provides meaningful support when our people need it most, especially those who have lost

segments.speaker: Rep. Salvador A. Pleyto
segments.text: their homes, livelihoods, and sense of security because of the calamities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Section 37B of that law provides that 50% of the 50% national government share from the income of PAGCOR will be used by PhilHealth for its benefit package.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Also in the same law, it provided that remittance from PAGCOR should have started in 2020 or one year after the enactment of the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: My first question is, was PAGCOR able to comply with this provision?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes

segments.text: Madam Chairperson, I'd like to answer.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, from the implementation of the said Republic Act, PAGCOR has religiously remitted its shares to the national government.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Now, as I had also clarified this in one of the hearings in the Senate, it is not the responsibility of PAGCOR to remit directly to PhilHealth.

segments.text: So, good morning. May mga konting katanungan lang po, Madam Chair, sa ating PAGCOR. Una po yung ating displacement and mass layoff from casino privatization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So, PAGCOR plans to privatize around 40 casino Filipino properties, potentially affecting approximately 10,000 regular and contractual employees.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Since asset sale ang structure, hindi automatic na required ang private buyers na i-retain ang existing workforce.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: May proposed 50-70% employee absorption requirement, pero maaari itong makapektos sa valuation at bids dahil sa additional labor costs and liabilities.

segments.text: Ang katanungan ko po sa PAGCOR, Madam Chair, is sa privatization ng said 40 casino Filipino properties.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Ilan po sa approximately 10,000 employees ang projected na ma-displace or ma-retrench?

segments.text: At kung ang proposed 50-70% employee absorption requirement ay mag-resulta sa lower bids, ano ang magiging priority ng PAGCOR?

segments.text: Maximizing privatization proceeds or protecting existing jobs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos

segments.text: or wala kang ginagawa sa lisensya mo, effective po nung July 1.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Meron na pong minimum na 9 million pesos na minimum guarantee fee

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And then, ang BIR naman po may karagdagang 5%.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, kung ikaw po ay isang GSA, meron ka na pong minimum na dapat bayaran na 10.5 million pesos.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: 9 million sa PAGCOR and 1.5 million po sa Bureau of Internal Revenue.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, yung mga dormant po or yung mga nag-iintay lang na may balak na magbenta or whatever,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: eh wala namang activity pa sa pangkasalukuyan, napakabigat po.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kung sila yung maglalabas ng 10.5 million pesos sa month,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: meron na rin pong ilan na nag-surrender na po ng kanilang lisensya.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And this for me is a very good program para po ma-rationalize

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: tsaka ma-stabilize na natin yung online gaming industry natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: You answered my next question about those mga dormant, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Sa Department of Energy, tinatawag namin service contract.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Bibili lang sila, maghihintay sila ng buyer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in your case, wala nang ganun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Well, Your Honor, Congressman, I cannot claim that hindi na po mangyayari.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero ang malaking deterrent po talaga eh yung namumuhunan sila ng karagdagan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: 10.5 ng 10.5 billion, medyo mabigat din po yun kung talagang wala kayong ginagawa.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: naging feedback po namin bigla ngayon, wala na po halos nagbebenta.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Magsusurrender na lang po sila ng lisensya.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, yan po ay isang programang ipinatupad po ng inyong lingkod nitong ika-isa ng Hulyo nitong taong ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Under your corporate mandate, nakalagay dito, number one,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: regulate, operate, authorize, and license games of chance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Cards and numbers, particularly casino gaming in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, ano itong, when you say games of chance, ano mga under neto?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Well, ang totoo po, ang na-under lang dyan, na inabutan ko na po,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ay yun talagang casino games, tsaka po itong online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero pagdating po sa horse racing, under po yan sa gab.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Cock fighting, under po yan sa gab.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yung isa po palang nawala rin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Namin, nadating nan dyan, ay yung pong online sabong.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Halimbawa, so games of chance po na-classify, pero nawala na rin po yan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, sa pangkasalukuyan po, yung in reference to games of chance,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ang tinutukoy po dyan ay mga casino games at yung online gaming games.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, casino games and online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Hindi yung kagay sinabi mo yung horse racing, that's under gab.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Nasa gab po ang horse racing, tsaka meron po yung Philippine Racing Commission.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Tapos, yung pong ibang cock fighting, sa gab din po yan, wala po sa PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Okay. So, anything, basta sa inyo, online.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Online and yung pong games of chance, yung casino games.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Yung pong nakikita natin sa mga land-based casinos natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, anything land-based casino, under casino property nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, online gaming is under PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And again, I would like to reiterate my point that I raised a clarificatory question ago

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: about the budget, no, that being taken away from PAGCOR

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: vis-a-vis to Philippine Sports Commission na dapat ibalik sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kasi ang dami nyo natutulungan, sa totoo lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you, PAGCOR family.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, Chairman Tengco.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you so much, Representative Presley De Jesus.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We'll now move to our next interpellator from the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We have two, but they don't seem to be here in the room.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ah, okay. Sorry, Brian. I didn't see you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Next, from the minority, Representative Brian Poe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: My apologies. Majority. From the majority, Representative Brian Poe.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So, first and foremost, Madam Chair, I just want to thank the PAGCOR chairman

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: because immediately after our previous hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: 44 out of the 52 illegal websites that we mentioned were immediately taken down.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: However, Madam Chair, I'd like to bring up that some of these sites are now accessible again.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: I have a list here of the websites which you can still access via the computer.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: My team is pulling it up on the laptop so that we can show it to them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: But to save time, we will submit it to the committee just so that PAGCOR can also follow up on this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Aside from that, I also want to point out that PAGCOR, if I'm not mistaken,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: your GRR or Gross Gaming Revenues in 2025,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, how much are we looking at in terms of GGR for 2025 again?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I think it was mentioned earlier.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Are you, Your Honor, are you referring to 2025 or 2026?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: For 2026, there is already a decline for both land-based casinos and online gaming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: We are looking at about P370 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: If we're looking at P370 billion pesos,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: we're looking at how much in terms of the annual wagering turnover for 2026.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, kumbaga, the gross revenue po that we,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: are able to get is, yes, sir.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: As, Your Honor, as gross gaming revenue is defined by total bets, less payouts.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So, maybe I should say the total wages placed will be in the vicinity of about P3 trillion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: The reason why I bring this up, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: is because if there's about P3 trillion pesos that are being wagered per annum,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: and we're getting about P300 plus billion in gross revenue from this,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: can you imagine how much of the undeclared revenue

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: or how much of the undeclared annual wagers we're missing out on in terms of government revenue,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: which could go towards government projects, government services?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And if we look here, for example,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: I just pulled up PopoLive, which is accessible online again.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, may I ask if PopoLive and these other apps,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: sorry, these other apps and websites from last year were able to secure a gambling license from PAGCOR?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, I believe we have not issued a license,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: primarily because we have, since last two years,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, I am 100% sure they remain to be part of the illegal operators operating in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, if you don't mind, I just want to say that

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I'd like to thank you for recognizing the fact that

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: when you brought out the name,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: the names of the illegal operators last year,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: they were pulled down or put up.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: That was not because of us.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: We did make the recommendation to the DICT, CICC, and the NTC.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Because they are, Your Honor, the ones with the police powers.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: They are the ones who have the power.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: There is nothing to be done but to make a recommendation,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: to make a recommendation, and to make a recommendation only.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, I just want to give credit where credit is due.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Because we are the ones who just recommended and just said

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: here in these government agencies that these are illegal and their operations must continue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, I'd like to thank the PAGCOR chairman for clarifying that until now,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: these apps and these gaming sites do not have a license.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Madam Chair, may I ask kung kasama po sa GGR ang revenue galing sa mga apps

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: or yung mga wagers placed on any of these websites or apps?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: We only track the GGR of our legal operators or our PAGCOR licenses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, I bring this up kasi kung tutuusin itong mga sites na ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: yung GGR natin is already in the billions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: The total annual wager tracked is estimated at around 3 trillion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: What more if these apps, these websites were properly tracked or suspended?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kasi kung suspended po sila, then they will only gamble through the legal websites.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yes, you are right, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yun po ang sinasabi ko kanina,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: na 50% lang po ng industriya ang may lisensya,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: You can just imagine, Your Honor, Congressman po,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: what government is losing in terms of potential revenue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kaya talagang, dapat talagang pagtulungan na ating masugpo itong mga illegal na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Malaki po, nawawala sa atin lahat dyan sa nangyayaring yan, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, what's important here is during this committee hearing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: nabanggit po ni Chairman that wala pang na-issue na bago na lisensya because there's a moratorium.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: 50% lang ang nakukuha natin na revenue.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Instead, we could be doubling the government revenue that we could possibly get from this to put into programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, moving on quickly to my next set of questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, PAGCOR pointed out that there are many,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: there are many nation building programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kumbaga, they have the school building program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: they have the patient transport vehicles which they have donated,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: relief ops that they have conducted,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: and other, a medical center even that they've inaugurated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Pero gusto kong magtanong kung meron po silang donations or funding po para sa mental health services para sa mga gambling addicts po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kasi kung tutuusin itong mga working class citizens po natin na nagiging biktima po ng online gaming

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: naghahanap ng solusyon ng paraan para iwasan itong gambling habit nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And I was hoping that PAGCOR might have some mental health programs that they are funding or that they are supporting

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: so that it could be free for our constituents

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: who can't afford mental health services.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: That is part of our responsible gaming programs.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: As I had mentioned, we have our partner, Seagulls Flock Foundation.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And sila po ay, sila ang nagpapatakbo ng 24-7 call center na sumasagot sa mga may problema

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At tulad ng ipinangako ko kanina, magsusumiti po kami ng report sa committee nito

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: para mapakita kung ilan na po yung ating mga natulungan tungkol sa mga himihingi ng tulong dahil sila ay,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: meron na, nalululunan sila sa pagsusugal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: We will do that and we will submit to the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So that it can be disseminated to all our, to the members of the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, I'd like to request for a copy of those programs, the number of people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: the number of people who have been helped, how much funding has gone into it,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: kasi importante at mahalaga po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Tulad ng sinabi ni Rep. Elie earlier,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: we do have a gambling addiction problem here in this country that we want to address.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: We want it to be responsible, we want it to be well-managed,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: but we also want people to have options para kung gusto nila tigilin tong habit na to,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: pwede naman sila mag-seek ng help galing sa gobyerno po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So, further, I just want to ask also, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: if PAGCOR, given all of its efforts with law enforcement,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: is only able to address 50% of the gambling that takes place in this country,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: what programs or what, I guess, facilities in CICC, DICT,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: can we add funding to or can we strengthen

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: in order for us to address all this illegal online gaming?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, in our discussions since last year with DICT,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: and CICC, headed by ASEC Aboy Paraíso,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: there are certain tools that they need to procure.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: talagang because of the advances of technology,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, I think they're in the process now of procuring

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: or about to procure equipment that can track

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: those that are using VPNs to shadow their presence.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I think that is what they will be lobbying for sa Kongreso.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: hindi ko po maaaring pakialaman yung kanilang teritoryo.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kami po ay rekomendatory sa kanila.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And, I can say one thing.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: The last year, our collaboration with DICT,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: between DICT, CICC, NTC and PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: really been so good na we continue to close so many illegal sites.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Unfortunately, kung anong bilis ng pagsasara,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ganon din bilis ang pagbubukas nila muli because of so many things that they can do.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So, that's it. That's my answer to your question, Your Honor, Kong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Thank you. Madam Chair, if I may, just a quick anecdote about that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: I want to note the efforts of the NBI, CICC, and PAGCOR because I've actually joined them po sa mga raids nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And I see the effort that they're putting into it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: But the reason why I bring up this question is because could we have a list from PAGCOR

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: kung ano yung mga equipment na kailangan i-procure ng CICC at ibang law enforcement at magkano po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kasi I want to see how much it will cost versus how much revenue we would be able to,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: how much revenue we would be able to generate from properly monitoring.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kung meron po tayong projection na kung meron tayong ganitong klaseng equipment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: we will be able to increase the number of websites that we're able to monitor and take down, etc.,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: how much we would be able to generate in revenue if we have proper policing through these machineries and technologies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Chair, if we make this investment in proper policing,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: maybe we could increase government revenue in the succeeding year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: At least that's the way I see it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Yun lang po. And thank you for the time, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Vice Chair Bryan po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Actually, I think it's fitting because Vice Chair Bryan po is anyways defending the budget of the DICT.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So you can also pose that same question to the CICC when we deliberate on the budget of DICT.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Sigur po, we'll just wait, Kong Bryan, so we can also share with PAGCOR the websites,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: the screenshot of the websites that you've pointed out earlier.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: But it's really a matter of enforcement and reinforcement given, as Chair Al was saying,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: as soon as those sites are taken down after a while, they go back up again.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Ikaw naman magpapreside ng DICT budget hearing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: So you can also bring it up with CICC when the time comes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, Chair Al.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you so much, Vice Chair Bryan po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We'll now move to the next interpellator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: From the minority, Representative Robert Nazal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Allow me first to commend PAGCOR and PAGCOR family for its commendable initiatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: particularly the nationwide school building program and the donation of patient transport vehicles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: These efforts have brought real benefit to many of our communities and we are grateful for that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: If I may, however, raise a small concern.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Mayroon po ako kasing pending request na more than one year na ang anniversary

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ng mga wheelchairs and mga ambulances para sa mga constituent natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: I mentioned this not as a complaint, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But simply to ask in the spirit of transparency, may pagkakaiba po ba ang minority ang nag-request?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang totoo po dun sa PTV, kami po nag-augment lang talaga sa PCSO.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At hindi naman talaga naming gawa ay magbigay.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Tumulong po kami. Nagpasobra na ng konti.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, yung pong request niyo eh, titinan ko kaagad pagkatapos nito

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ng mapatunayan sa inyong wala pong pagkakaiba ang minority at majority

segments.speaker: Committee/agency brief acknowledgment
segments.text: pag ang PAGCOR po ang timitiin dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you, thank you, Mr. Chair. Salamat po diyan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, I will go directly to my questions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Madam Chair, I would like to clarify the effect of the planned privatization of Casino Filipino

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: In Section 37 of the UHC Act, 50% of the national government share from PAGCOR income

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Once PAGCOR disposes of its Casino Filipino operations and becomes purely a regulatory body,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: what happens to the UHC earmark?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Will the national government share, and therefore yung 50% going to PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: due to be computed from PAGCOR's entire gaming-related income,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: including regulatory fees and license fee shares from private casinos, e-games, and other licenses?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Or will the legal revenue base covered by the UHC earmark become smaller

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: once PAGCOR is no longer itself a gaming operator?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Na compute na po ba ng PAGCOR with the deal,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: together with the DOF, DBM, and PhilHealth,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: na quantify na po ba natin yung UHC contribution before and after privatization?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And if so, can you please give the committee the projected PAGCOR contribution to UHC

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: for 2026, 2027, and 2028, and the first full year after privatization?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yes, na compute na po, at ang totoo po eh,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kung meron pong nag-aaral niya ng lubos ngayon,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: eh yung pong GCG, Governance Commission for GOCCs.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ang magre-rekomenda po sa tanggapan ng Pangulo ay ang GCG.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sila po ang magre-rekomenda kung dapat ma-ituloy

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: or dapat matuloy ang decoupling privatization.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, nakita na po namin yan, pinag-aaralan po,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: miyembro po din ng GCG Commission, ang PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ah, ang Secretary of Finance, gayon din po ang Secretary of Budget and Management, DBM.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sila po eh ex-officio members ito.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, maliwanag po na pinag-aaralan po at nakita na po yan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sa aming pong internal na pag-aaral, nakita po namin na hindi po in the long run,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: in the medium term, ah, hindi lang po magpapantay, mahigitan pa.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Because of the operational efficiency po na mangyayari.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, sa ngayon po kasi, binanggit ko nga kanina eh,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: napangakin na po ng drug ng karga ng ah, salaries and wages ng empleyado.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Gayon din naman po ng halimbawa ay yung ating ah, rentals sa different properties natin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ah, himigit ko mo lang po, one and a half billion pesos a month ang nagagastos natin dito.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, kapag nawala po lahat yan, eh, tataas po yung income ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And sa huli naman po, may contribution kami na minimum of 50% of our net profit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, that will neutralize in the long run yung pong adjustments na mangyayari.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Magkano po ba yung expected revenues natin once ma-privatize?

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And how much are you projecting will be the share on the first year or the first and second year alone?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Wala po kasi, ah, Your Honor, ah, wala po kasi kaming control.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Basta yung amin lang is we remit our share to the national government.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And it is the national government that supposedly remits to the PhilHealth or to the Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang liniliwanag ko po kanina pa, we have been updated.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, nasa sa national treasury na po yung pagbibigay.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kasi meron pong kumisang hindi pagkakaintindihan na kami po ang nagre-remit sa Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang nangyayari po, on a monthly basis, kami po ay nagbibigay sa national treasury.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At pagkatapos, obligasyon na rin po at responsibilidad nila ang mag-remit sa Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, sa ngayon po, I just want to clarify this, just like I, how I answered earlier, I think you were not present.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Wala po kaming control dun sa remittance to the, because ang batas po maliwanag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Remit your share to the national government and the national government will remit 50% of what you have remitted to the Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, what you're saying, Mr. Chair, Madam Chair, is that you have no figures on how much is being remitted to PhilHealth?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Well, we, it's not that we do not have figures, we do not have control.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But, I'll just give you an example, for year 2025, for example, we remitted more or less 50 billion pesos to the national treasury.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: That means, following the intent of the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But, the reason you're saying this, Madam Chair, is because, meron po bang naging deviation from the, what you remitted to the national treasury?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Wala ah, hindi na po namin alam yun eh.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sapagkat sabi ko nga, buwanan po, we remit to the national treasury.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And, the law states, the national treasury or the national government should remit,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: should remit 50% of what we have remitted to the Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Now, whether they're remitting or not is beyond our control already.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: That is what I'm trying to point out, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ah, and that was asked earlier also.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, kasi may akala po sila na diretsyo po kaming nagre-remit sa Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Remit 50% of your revenue to the national government and the government under the Universal Healthcare Act must remit 50% of what we have remitted to the Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
