segments.text: Considering the privatization, ah, Madam Chair, meron po bang, meron po ba kayo nakikita na dapat baguhin ng Congress in terms of legislation para, ah, mag-guarantee na ganon pa rin yung magiging,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: income or share ng UHC sa kikitain ng, ah, sa manggagaling po sa privatization?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Opo, ah, kami po ay, ah, gumawa na rin ng aming mga sariling computations.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I think, ah, may, may certain numbers kami.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero this we can share with the committee.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Maybe the committee can share with you.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But, ah, we will forward what we have done internally.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But making clear that sa ngayon po, yun ni base lamang sa projections namin after the implementation of the decoupling slash privatization.

segments.speaker: Committee/agency brief acknowledgment
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you for that, Madam Chair, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Kung magkakaroon po tayo ng transitional revenue habang naglilipat ng operations sa private sector, ang PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: ang one-time windfall mula sa privatization ay dapat magsilbing safety cushion para sa UHC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Since PAGCOR estimates P30 to P50 billion in proceeds from the sale of casino Filipino assets and licenses,

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: direct UHC collections might experience transition friction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: So, is the Executive willing to commit or does Congress need to legislate a sort of transitional healthcare stabilization fund

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: sourced directly from the privatization proceeds to guarantee that PhilHealth's annual subsidy is protected?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Para captured pa rin po yung windfall?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, we can look into that.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: As I said earlier in another question, the priority use of the proceeds of the retirement,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: which is now being trimmed down to about 30 on the high side because of the decline,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: our priority is being able to pay the retirement of our employees because that, for me,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: is a commitment to protect the interests of our PAGCOR employees.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, coming from kung magkakaroon po ng difference doon sa proceeds and yung binayad natin sa retirement,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: then I think that can be considered as a possibility na magkaroon ng cushion fund, as you had mentioned earlier.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: that from my standpoint, the priority also for me is being able to pay the retirement benefits

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: and the special incentive package of those who will be affected by this move to decouple PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Magkano po ba yung ano? How much will we spend?

segments.speaker: Committee/agency brief acknowledgment
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, you're talking for retirement.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: We're looking at about 28 to 30 billion as the money needed for the retirement.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Today, we have close to about 12 billion.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, we will be subsidizing coming from the sale.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And the difference, as I mentioned, maybe that can be...

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And we can study whether that difference can be used as a stabilization fund for the universal healthcare.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: How much, Madam Chair, is the expected windfall?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: You're talking from where, Your Honor?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: We're looking at about mga 25 to 30 billion po sa pangkasalukuyan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: As I said, we have a current retirement fund of about 12 billion.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, magkakaroon po ng positive later on, I'm sure, kahit papano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Currently po, ang retirement fund ay nagkakahalaga ng mga 12 billion pesos cash in bank na po yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: But after all the expenses, all the retirement benefits and whatever you need to pay,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: upon completion of the privatization, saan po initially dapat ilalagay yung windfall?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Roberto Nazal
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And that being so, we will be remitting 50% of that later on to the National Treasury.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sana nga po, doon na lang sa kusyon ilagay and i-prioritize natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So that the UHC is prioritized, hindi po maapektuhan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I'd like to thank you for your suggestion so that we can look into the matter, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: Thank you to the PAGCOR family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
segments.text: And please expect your request to be delivered within 48 hours.

segments.speaker: Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Roberto Nazal
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, Representative Nazal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: As committed by Chair Al, like all the documentary requirements would be provided within 48 hours after the hearing.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, Chairman Albeca.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, thank you, Representative Robert Nazal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: We now move to our next interpellator, Representative Julienne “Jam” Baronda, also from the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: This is more or less commendation of your accomplished, many things that you have accomplished.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Indeed, the men and women headed by, of course, our Chairman Tengco of PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: It's not only good in managing PAGCOR, but at the same time, you're a good dancer, a good singer, sir, right?

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, but I would like to commend all of you for a job well done.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Despite and in spite the challenges you've been facing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And especially with the recent decision of the Supreme Court, this would probably take more than almost 2 billion a year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: 3 billion a year, including your arrears for your almost 33 years.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So, but with your initiative in partnering with the ICT, I believe you'd be able to.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Now, my only concern is, this is about the implementation of universal healthcare, which you've answered earlier.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I would just like to ask if you have this, like, 5-year contingency plan, how you'd be able to still support universal healthcare,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: This recent decision of Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, first of all, salamat po sa recognition ninyo na ang PAGCOR po ay nakatutulong sa buong bansa at sa ating mga kababayan, despite all the challenges.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At sa abot na aming makakaya, we will continue to reach out to as many Filipinos as we can in the next few years that I am chairman and CEO of PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: To answer your question, Your Honor, Congresswoman Jam, ang nakikita ko pong maliwanag na magaganap ay,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kung talaga pong natuloy ang decoupling slash privatization, malaki po ang magiging menos sa gastos ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Hindi man po ganung kalaki ang magiging revenue kung sakali magtuloy-tuloy itong challenges na mga kinaharap natin sa pangkasalukuyan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Iisa pong maliwanag, liliit po ng malaki ang gastos.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sa personal lamang, at sa upa lamang, at sa pagbayad lamang ng utilities,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ay in-estimate po namin yan mga 15 billion piso sa isang daon.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ibig sabihin po niyan, yung bottom figure ng PAGCOR ay mananatiling matatag,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And dahilan sa automatic na ang batas naman,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ay nakasaad doon, 50% ng kita ng PAGCOR ay pupunta sa national government.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sa paniniwala ko po, pag na-stabilize na po ang lahat ng ito,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: tulad naman ng anong uri ng pagbabago, may tinatawag na period of adjustment.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero pag naalpasa na po natin itong period of adjustment na ito,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: natitiya ko po sa inyo, your honor,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At natitiya ko po sa inyo na magiging matatag po lalo ang financial health ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And that means, protektado po yung nakasaad sa batas na magsishare po tayo sa Universal Healthcare Fund.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: With that, Madam Chair, I believe with the good leadership of Chairman Al,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: we'd be able to deliver what is expected from you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I would just like to commend especially your program with Integrated Resorts Foundation in Clark.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: In Western Visayas, Region 6, in Western Visayas Medical Center, it is our specialty hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And alongside with Center JV, we expanded the hospital bed capacity from 420 to 700.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So if you've mentioned that POG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: we're supported with your partnership with the SED Foundation in construction of the Children's Hospital.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Now we are in need of the equipping of our cancer center at Western Visayas Medical Center.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: If you would also consider helping us, LIAs us, with the Integrated Resorts Foundation.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sa harapan pong to, kinukumit ko po, kami ay susuporta at magdudonate ng medical equipment dun sa expanded hospital ninyo.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Tulad ng ginawa namin dito sa specialty hospital sa Central Luzon,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I don't think problema naman na hanggang Western Visayas ay makatulong din kami.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Nangyari pong umupo tayo at nang sa ganun mapag-usapan natin sa tulong ni dating Congresswoman Nialla Aguinaldo kung paano kami makakatulong dito sa expanded medical specialty hospital ninyo sa Western Visayas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Chair, actually parang nabuhayan ako nung nakita ko si former Congresswoman Nialla Aguinaldo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I hope she can be of help to us, hindi lang sa akin but buong Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Actually po, with the recent shooting in Zamboanga, and one of the persons, one of the person involved is may problema.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: So sa DepEd, especially sa mga spread.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: At ISEC na schools, wala po tayong massive support for children with special needs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Baka pwede nyo po makonsider kasi really need your support, especially by providing equipment in their respective schools at the same time building.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kasi iba ang requirement ng children.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Baka makonsider nyo ito, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So definitely, Your Honor, Congresswoman Jam, we will be considering this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And may I suggest that it form part of the agenda in our meeting with former Congresswoman Nialla Aguinaldo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: I will coordinate with Secretary Angara.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: For him to provide list of the regions that needed special care and attention when it comes to your support for children with special needs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Lastly po, please know that I would always be very supportive of the programming endeavor of PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And I would like also to commend PAGCOR for having this PAGCOR Dakila Awards for...

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: And last year, you've awarded several women in power because of their services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Ang tanong ko lang po, kung ano ang mga requirements, ano po yung mga indicators for us to give awards for different...

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Public servants, not only the local, but also in the national level.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Opo, ma'am, actually it's a program extended or implemented because of the requirements of the GAD law.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I'll be very honest, I am not privy to the details, but as I had mentioned to you earlier, I will be in discussions with the person in charge and ask her all the questions and maybe I will ask her to get in touch with you so we can clear and clarify everything regarding this project.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Well, I just wanted to make sure that this program will be long-term in nature. At the same time, can we not only include women in government, but of course, especially for our supporters from private sectors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Again, thank you so much, PAGCOR family. I look forward to working and collaborating with you in providing best healthcare for our Filipino people. God bless.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Thank you so much, your honor, for your suggestions. I really like the suggestion on the special children. So, PAGCOR has not yet had any projects. And I think this will be an opportunity for PAGCOR to touch the lives and the families of these special children. So, we will seriously look into this matter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
Rep. Julienne "Jam" L. Baronda
segments.text: Because in Iloilo City alone, there are more than 500 children who are being initially diagnosed with special needs. So, in the whole of the Philippines, how many are there? And remember, the person involved in some buwanga is also someone that needs special attention. So, with this, I believe more people will be able to help. Thank you again, Chairman.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you, Representative Jam Baronda. Next to interpellate from the minority, Representative Bong Suntay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, the earnings of PAGCOR come from casino funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Filipino operations, licensed casinos, digital gaming, e-games, and non-gaming income.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Now, when it comes to casino Filipino operations, because the data that I have is past 2024,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: how much is the income of PAGCOR from casino Filipino operations for 2026?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: For 2026, we're projecting gross gaming revenue to be down to about Php 10 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So from Php 12.6 million in 2024, now it's Php 10 billion?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: That's high. I project to hit between Php 9 billion and Php 10 billion only.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Now, how much is the income of casino Filipino operations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: We will be sending also the committee to the casino Filipino list of our casino Filipino properties.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Now, and with regards to the licensed casino operations, how much was the revenue for 2026?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Projected revenue for 2026 of licensed casinos excluding casino Filipino.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: We're looking at about Php 31, Php 31.5 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Php 31.5. So it's also down from Php 33 in 2024.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yes, sir. Yes, Your Honor. Sorry.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Now, for digital, can I also have a list of our private casinos and the respective revenues coming from each?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yes, what Your Honor, we can do is send the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: We can send the committee a complete list in detail of our revenue coming from licensed casinos, from casino Filipino, and from online gaming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: These are the three major revenue drivers of PAGCOR today, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Okay. Now, for digital e-games, how much is the projected revenue for 2026?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: The projected revenue for 2026 is Php 38 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But the highest revenue generator would now be digital e-games.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Although as I have already mentioned earlier, now the trend is that licensed casinos are gradually surpassing online gaming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Now, regarding this development, do you consider this a positive development or a source of concern na yung revenue ng PAGCOR comes heavily from e-games or online gaming?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Actually, sa amin pong pag-aaral, it is both plus and minus.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Plus in the sense na kung wala po ito, lalong hirap na hirap na ang PAGCOR sa pangkasalukuyan dahil pataas po yung gastos at napakalaki ng sweldo ng mga empleyado. So kung hindi po dumating yung online gaming, malaki na po ang problema ng PAGCOR sa pangkasalukuyan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: If online gaming does not come, the problem of PAGCOR in the present is already big.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But a minus because I'm concerned that the big licensees are also seeing a decline in revenue.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: There's a time when it's really low, there's a time when it's going to rise again.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Like what we all saw, when we had a problem with COVID, when we had the pandemic,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: the income of licensed casinos really increased.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But when it recovered, it rebelled.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: The revenue of this really increased.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Now, because of all these problems we are encountering,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: the Middle East crisis, the economic backlash in the world,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: it looks like the revenue of licensed casinos is going to drop.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But like the historical data I'm reading,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: all the 40, almost 45 years of PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: its revenue really has a cycle.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: However, we can't really avoid not accepting online gaming

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: because digital advances in technology are already dictating.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Plus, the whole world, including the United Arab Emirates,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: can you imagine, will already be given a license by 2027.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: The countries in Europe, there are already a lot of people announcing that they will also be given a license for online gaming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, if we don't worry about this and just let it go,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: there's a lot of loss in our revenue for our government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because while the concern of others,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: while their concern is the dwindling revenue,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Where will the revenue of PAGCOR come from?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: You also mentioned earlier, Chairman Al,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: that usually, the one who plays online games comes from CDE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, it means, that's where the money will come from.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And then we are spending, well, you are giving,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: How much did you give for the share for the social programs of the President?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And also, the one you are using for social outreach?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Maybe in one year, there will be a decrease of about 15 million.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, isn't it ironic that the one who is in charge of online gaming

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: and then we will release money for social projects

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: in the amount of about 18 billion,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: not to mention the President's Social Fund also,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: which is also being used there,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: The people who are also getting money,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: where the money is also coming from.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: That's why, that's the cause of my concern.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because fundamentally, the architectural framework of online gaming is different.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Unlike physical casinos, there are also physical barriers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: you will see if you are young, if you are poor, if you have money,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, this was the same question that I asked PAGCOR during the 18th Congress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: during the time when the economy was closed,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: the Filipinos were unable to work,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: the government allowed the proliferation of E-Sabong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: The security guards, the children, the people without money.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So, isn't it important that before we open or expand online gaming,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: we have to strengthen first our regulatory powers

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, I totally agree with you,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: advances in technology are too fast

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: that we cannot not follow suit.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Because what will happen, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: it will be illegal for the technology to flourish.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Because the illegals are the ones who are saddened.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: There are no illegals here in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, I understand what you are saying.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But we cannot continue to fight for the present.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Because we will eat the illegals.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: That's why Congressman Ryan mentioned earlier that the place we closed that he requested is now open again.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, no matter how hard it is, we need to look at what you are saying.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At the same time, we need to do the same with our online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Because if not, we will eat our lives.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, I totally agree with you, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: We are doing whatever we can.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: We are strengthening our structures and our online gaming guidelines, rules and regulations.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: We are updating it on a regular basis based on market trends.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: But unfortunately, we also have to...

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: go head-to-head with the online gaming industry.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because if we do not follow this, we will not be able to catch up with the illegal operators

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: who are constantly harassing our fellow citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, I'm not against online gaming.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: How can we properly police the people who play online games?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Whether they're minors, whether they come from the...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: We know that it comes from CDE.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And to allow them to continue to gamble...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: There's a shortage of medicine to buy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: There's a shortage of food to buy.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: There's a shortage of electricity to pay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: There's a shortage of education for the children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But usually, as your data would show...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: They are usually the customers of online gaming sites.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: We have to concentrate first on how to properly police these people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kawawa naman yung walang mangyayari sa bansa natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, the reason why, for example, in China, why they have restricted gambling,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: kasi ayaw nilang nagsusugal yung mga insek, masusto nilang magtrabaho yung mga kanilang mga citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And dito sa atin nga, what are the concrete steps that we have tried to take?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I understand that technology is evolving very fast, but we're not doing anything.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Walang pinagkaiba yan. Naalala ko nung tinesting ng gobyerno yung online na motorcycle na sinabi nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kayaan natin sila mag-operate without having a regulatory framework.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: By the time na ang dami nang nandun sa platform, hindi na nila kayang i-regulate.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Baka ganyan din yung mangyayari sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I can only answer that I guess we just have to look into it and see how we can strengthen the structures at the same time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Well, yun lang Madam Chair. I hope we really look into it and come up with ways to,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: to properly regulate it bago, bago ano, bago dumating sa size na hindi na natin kayang kontrolin talaga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Our next interpellator, Representative Mica Gonzales.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So I think, Chairman Al, I think you feel the sentiment of our colleagues is to protect

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: the Filipino people from excessive gambling, di ba po?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So in relating to that, I would like to ask, kasi ba, from the previous committee hearings of the Ames and Amusement here in the House,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: I asked regarding setting a cap or setting a limit per user.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: For example, meron tayong online gaming and meron tayong user na player.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: I asked them previously kung sino ba nasa set.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Nang cap or nang maximum bet nila per day or I don't know how we should call it, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Wala pala tayong sineset na cap per player.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So I would like to ask if up until now po, wala pa rin po ba kayong sineset na cap or limit per player in a day or in a week?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I'd be very candid and honest about it.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, we have not set, but I believe in the online gaming law that is being proposed,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: there will be an inclusion of these caps, whether caps on deposits and caps of gaming activity.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Yun po ang, Your Honor, yun po ang gustong patunguan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Nang parehong committee sa Senado, gayon din sa Kongreso, para po ma-address yung binabanggit ninyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Since it was also opened na yung online gaming is mas madali, is more accessible compared to, you know, going to a casino, you know, playing there.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: And we all know that government employees are not allowed to play sa casino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: And do we have, sa online gaming po ba, how can they detect na, oh, ito, ano to, polis to, oh, ito, they work for the government.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Mayroon po ba tayong mechanism to ensure that government employees will not and are not allowed to play, even if it's online gaming?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, definitely, we are strictly implementing the KYC process,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Lahat po ng licenses ay dapat suriin ng mabuti yung mga magre-rehistro sa kanila.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At kung dumating po yung pagkakataon na nakalusot sila, yung secondary screening po naman na ginagawa ng PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: and we have been very successful, Your Honor, ay yung pagvo-void ng kanilang panalo.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kung sa kanilang may nakalusot na isang government employee na nakapaglaro at sila'y swinerte at nanalo,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: bago po nila ma-withdraw yun, marami din pong screening yun.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, pag na-discovery po na sila'y empleyado ng gobyerno, whether siya po'y isang opisyal o isang karaniwang empleyado lamang,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And I can say, I can tell you and members of the committee that in the last two years,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: we have voided close to half a billion pesos worth of winnings already sapagkat na-discovery po namin

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: na ang mga nanalong ito ay mga empleyado o kawani ng ating pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yun po yung secondary screening process.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Natupad po namin nitong panunungkulan ko bilang Pagcourt Chairman and CEO.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pero ang mahalaga po at ang unang hakbang ay sa registration pa lamang, yung pong tinataw na KYC.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Unfortunately, Your Honor, meron pa pong nakalulusot doon.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Nagsusumiti ng fake na ID halimbawa or hindi dinidisclose na sila'y kawani ng pamahalaan,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At sabi ko nga, doon pong pagsala roon, eh yun ang pag mag-reclaim na sila ng premyo,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: doon naman papasok yung paghihingi muli ng final submission mo ng ID.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: At doon nga po, matagumpay namin masasabi na naging maganda yung programa

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: dahil sa marami na po kaming vinoid na winnings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Thank you, Madam Chair Chairman Al.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: That is for the kasino po na pwedeng puntahan but I would also like to ask if meron na po ba tayong sort of security mechanism sa online gaming?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Like yung mga, alam mo yung sa Facebook, yung mga ads.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So do we have some sort of mechanism to ensure that the player is not a government employee?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yes, that is through the KYC process, ma'am.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang totoo, maski magsubok kayo, hindi kayo makakamagiging member or magiging player ng isang legal license kasino

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kung ikaw ay government employee dahilan sa KYC.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Ang malaki pong problema, Your Honor, yung iligal po.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sapagkat sa iligal, wala pong KYC process.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Occupation or identification, yun po ang malaking problema natin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kaya, Your Honor, po ulit-ulit kong sinasabi, ang problema po ng industriyang ito ay yung iligal.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Dahil sa iligal operators, tinatanggap po maski minor de edad, maski teenager.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Samantalang dito po sa proseso natin sa may lisensya sa online,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: halos, sabihin na natin, high 90s in percentage na ang dumataan sa very strict process of KYC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: So, last question na lamang po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Since we have stern warning sa mga kasino operators po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: do we also have sort of mechanism of,

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: mechanism on players na they could be permanently blocked from a casino?

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Like for example, I don't know, do we have some sort of instances na we permanently blocked off a player in entering a casino?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, I did report earlier, as of today, we have a list that contains 15,000 names,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kung saan, they are not allowed to enter any of the casinos,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: nor they are allowed to play in online gaming platforms.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yun po ay na-generate natin sa pamamagitan ng programang self-exclusion at family exclusion.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kung saan, ang isang nalululun na sa sugal ay pwedeng sumulat sa akin or sa PAGCOR,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: para magsabing ayoko na magsugal, ipaban niyo po ako.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So, that ban is there for years.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Hindi po natin linilift basta-basta yun.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Pagdating naman po sa, kung ikaw ay nakalista sa National Database of Restricted Personnel,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: yun po ay nakakalat din sa lahat ng kasinos at marami po ang nahuhuli

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Meron din po kaming family exclusion program kung saan ang isang asawa or ang kapamilya

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ay pwedeng mag-request sa PAGCOR na hindi na pwedeng papasukin ang kanyang kamag-anak,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: kanyang asawa, ang kanyang ama, ang kanyang anak sa mga casinos at online gaming sites natin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: 15,000 na po ang numero na meron tayo.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: At nitong nakaraang taon lamang, meron pong halos labing isang libo mahigit

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ang nag-apply for self-exclusion program ng PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Alyssa Michaela "Mica" M. Gonzales
segments.text: Okay, thank you. That will be all. Thank you Chairman Al and thank you Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: There's one more signed up from the minority, Representative Jernie Jett Nisay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: However, as I'm not seeing Kong Jet here, we'll move to the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Our next interpellator, Representative Shirlyn Bañas-Nograles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Since it's past lunch time already, I'll try to be brief.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Because we've noticed, just a follow-through po sa earlier queries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Since we've noticed that it's becoming prevalent to the detriment of the vulnerable sectors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: So, and given po the easy access to mobile portals via payment gateways,

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: meron po ba tayong stringent technical protocol imposed on licenses?

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: To prevent the minors, government employees, and even the low-income earners from gambling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Kasi especially po yung micro-bets, it allows one peso to five pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: So, even yung mga four-piece beneficiaries natin, talagang marami na rin po ang nalululong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: At second question ko po, isahin ko na lang para mabilis.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: In the report po, your relief operations for calamity victims,

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: I'm just interested to know how you allocate and operationalize this po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: If I may be allowed, I want to be a bit specific.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: In the recent earthquake that happened in General Santos City,

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: maybe some details just eluded me.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Meron po bang assistance extended yung pub core to General Santos City?

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: And second po, construction of classrooms

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: is also included among the priority projects of pub core.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: In Jansan, we have like 1,400 classrooms that were badly damaged by the 7.8 earthquake.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: May we know po if there has been commitment also from pub core,

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: since it is mentioned among your priority program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: The process is when there's a major calamity,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Doon po muna tayo sa first question.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Is there a stringent technical protocol?

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: The stringent measure, Your Honor, is the KYC process.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: You cannot register in an online gaming,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: I'm sure you're referring to online gaming.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: It will be difficult for you to register in an online gaming app

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: to become a regular customer or player

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: if you do not go to a,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And in that KYC, as I was explaining to Kong Micah earlier,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: bago po kayo makapaglaro, dapat makumpleto niyo yun.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And doon po ay nandun lahat ng datos ninyo.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Whether you are a government employee,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: whether, because you will have to present a valid government ID in that process.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Your Honor, ang problema po natin,

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: ay yung mga illegal operators na walang lisensya sa PAGCOR.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: They compose 50% of the total industry.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kasi wala ni isang uri ng proseso.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kaya kabataan ka, kaya mahirap ka, kaya nagtatrabaho ka sa pamahalan, pwede kang maglaro doon.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yun po ang nakasisira sa lehiti mong mga may lisensya.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: So that is my answer to question number one.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: With regard to your question number two, yes, we did support the victims of General Santos

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: by giving financial and relief packages.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: And we coordinated this with the Office of Civil Defense.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Sila po ang katulong namin nag-airlift ng lahat ng support at tulong namin.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: aside from that, you were asking what is the process?

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Pero, kung meron po kayo sa lugar ninyo na malaking disaster, malaking problema,

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: all you have to do is write me a letter or write PAGCOR a letter.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: And wala pong problema yun, we support.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: In fact, in the last week and a half, we have sent out more than 100,000 relief packs all over the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: And some of your colleagues have received also help.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: So, all you have to do, ma'am, is just write us and we will respond to the best of our ability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Maybe you can help us also with the classroom.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
segments.text: Classroom constructions because lots of our classrooms are really badly damaged because of...

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Yung pulang kasing reconstruction, we are not allowed sa repair.

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Kaya po, itong programa namin ito, the construction of 125 new school buildings

segments.speaker: PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: having an equivalent of about 1,200 classrooms na bago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
Rep. Shirlyn L. Bañas-Nograles
PAGCOR Chairman and CEO Alejandro H. Tengco
segments.text: Salamat din po sa inyo, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: Thank you very much, Representative Banias Nograles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
segments.text: As there are no other interpellators from the minority, we'll go to another member from the majority,

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Sana nakakain kayo habang sumasagot sa mga tanong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Ito kong tinitin ako itong Comparting Results of Operations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: Note that there was a decline from 2025 through 2027 projected for the income.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III
segments.text: And also do note that having attended the session earlier, that you have been faithfully remitting 50% sa pamalaan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonino B. Roman III

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Para maghanap po ng suporta sa inyo, baka naman po pwede sa amin maliit na bagay yung pagpapaayos or repairs ng school.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, baka naman po pwede pagtulungan natin ng minor repairs lang po yung paaralan.
